Agwrx Celebrates Milestone Work Anniversaries in September
Oct 01, 2026
| AgWrx
Congratulations to Sam Hubsch, our Webster location manager, on celebrating his milestone 25-year work anniversary this September!
Welcome Sarah Bruning to the Agwrx Team!
Sep 02, 2026
| AgWrx
We’re excited to welcome Sarah Bruning as our new Director of Human Resources!
Agwrx Celebrates Milestone Work Anniversaries in August
Aug 11, 2026
| AgWrx
Congratulations to John Guest Jr. on reaching 15 years of outstanding service on our team this August!
Agwrx Cooperative Donates $10,000 to Local 4-H Youth Programs
Aug 10, 2026
| AgWrx
This year, Agwrx invested $10,000 in five local county 4-H programs across the communities it serves. Agwrx is honored to support the families, volunteers and local 4-H organizations that make these programs an important part of our communities.
Thanksgiving
November 27, 2026
All Agwrx Cooperative offices and locations will be closed on Thursday, November 26, in observance of the Thanksgiving holiday. Normal operations will resume on Friday, November 27. We wish everyone a safe and happy Thanksgiving!
Christmas Day
December 25, 2026
All Agwrx Cooperative offices and locations will be closed on Friday, December 25, in observance of the Christmas Day holiday. Normal operations will resume on Monday, December 28. We wish everyone a Merry Christmas!
